description: Pinned normalized compatibility and transition facts used only as the deterministic grading authority.

gateCatalog.backup-and-health-green: Verified backups and all pre-upgrade health checks are green.
gateCatalog.entitlement-and-binaries: VCF 9.1 entitlements and the required component binaries are available.
gateCatalog.ops-first: VCF Operations 9.1 is healthy before SDDC lifecycle migration begins.
gateCatalog.ofn-cert-dns-ip-san: The Operations for Networks certificate contains both the node FQDN and IP address SAN entries.
gateCatalog.ofn-before-vcenter: VCF Operations for Networks 9.1 is healthy before vCenter is upgraded.
gateCatalog.management-services-healthy: VCF 9.1 management services and Fleet Lifecycle are healthy.
gateCatalog.inventory-migrated: The component inventory is registered in Fleet Lifecycle.
gateCatalog.nsx-vcenter-interop: The target NSX and vCenter combination passes the pinned interoperability check.
gateCatalog.vcenter-before-esxi: vCenter 9.1 is healthy before ESXi remediation starts.
gateCatalog.hardware-compatibility: Every ESXi host is on the VCF 9.1 hardware, driver, and firmware compatibility lists.
gateCatalog.identity-migration-complete: Identity configuration is migrated to the VCF 9.1 embedded identity service.
gateCatalog.log-service-enabled: VCF Log Management 9.1 is enabled and receiving new events.
gateCatalog.log-retention-verified: Required historical logs have been migrated and retention has been verified.
gateCatalog.recovery-pair-protected: Recovery plans, protection groups, and replication state are exported and recoverable.
gateCatalog.recovery-convergence-ready: The paired SRM and vSphere Replication appliances are ready for the supported unified-appliance convergence transition.
